ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: From the text, there were 5 parrots with an average value of €6000, so the total original value was 5 × €6000 = €30000. After one parrot escaped, 4 parrots remained with an average value of €5000, so their total value was 4 × €5000 = €20000. The escaped parrot's value is the difference between the original total and the remaining total: €30000 − €20000 = €10000.
